name: ZERO_COST_NORMALIZED_RESEARCH_SCHEMA_V1

team_metric_fields.goals: non-negative integer; observed final score only
team_metric_fields.xg: nullable non-negative float; real source value only
team_metric_fields.conversion: nullable fraction [0,1], deterministically goals/shots under same window
team_metric_fields.ppda: nullable positive rate under Metric Contract v1
team_metric_fields.set_piece_shots: nullable non-negative integer under Metric Contract v1
team_metric_fields.header_shots: nullable non-negative integer under Metric Contract v1

temporal_rules: target features use only fixtures with kickoff strictly before target kickoff
splits are chronological 60/20/20 and never random
current standings never enter historical features
post-match observations never enter a pre-match target
team_identity_policy: exact canonical mapping or reject; never guess
